fields.value: Follow-up from Task 3d4f40 verify (2026-11-07). tests/launch/test_runpod_machines.py:475 intermittently gets ('lost', 'create_unconfirmed') where it expects ('lost', 'input_undelivered'). Seen in CI run 42317106116 (merge queue for #85) and run 42372756710 (push of 199335c, the #86 merge), while the merge-queue run of that same commit passed. Failing run logs are the evidence; the cause is not yet known. Starting point: src/etude/launch/scheduler.py around line 2215 chooses create_unconfirmed when a machine is gone, the attempt has no started_at and the start is unknown. Decide whether the scheduler can misreport a real input refusal as create_unconfirmed (a product bug, which then also affects retry behaviour, since a create_unconfirmed loss may retry) or the fixture races. Fix the cause if real; otherwise delete the flake per AGENTS.md, no retries. Outcome: the failure cause is reported correctly every time and main's CI stops failing on this test. No paid compute.
